invitations.subject: Hirelix: free-trial invitation for an independent review
invitations.body:
Hello AI HR Atlas team,

Your contact page invites suggestions for tools to review. I'm Noah, founder of Hirelix, and I'd like to invite you to try it and give candid feedback.

Hirelix is a personal AI recruiting partner for independent recruiters and boutique search firms. It works with a recruiter's own CVs, role briefs and notes: compare candidates, research public information when requested, and prepare client recommendations. Saved records can be used in later conversations. It is not an ATS or a proprietary candidate database.

The existing free trial includes 7 days and 200 AI credits, with no credit card required: https://hirelix.online/?utm_source=aihratlas&utm_medium=review_invitation&utm_campaign=free_trial_20261030 . A useful first test is one role brief and two or three fictional or appropriately anonymized CVs.

We have no sponsorship budget. If the experience is useful and relevant to your readers, would you consider an independent review, newsletter mention, or sharing it on LinkedIn? There is no obligation to publish or give a positive verdict; any sharing should disclose the trial arrangement. We respect your editorial independence.

Here is our 35-second introduction: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Swe056HRryw . It is an illustrative animation with fictional people and companies, not a live search recording.

Best,
Noah Jiang
Founder, Hirelix
https://hirelix.online

If this invitation is not relevant, reply "opt out" and I won't follow up.
Mailing address: {{MAILING_ADDRESS_REQUIRED_BEFORE_SEND}}
